Container.Name: PeriodiCool
Container.Overview: Self-hosted manager for magazines, in the style of Sonarr: track titles, find new and back issues through your indexers (Prowlarr, Newznab, Torznab), send them to your download client (SABnzbd, NZBGet, qBittorrent, Transmission, Deluge, rTorrent or a blackhole folder), and keep the library organized. PeriodiCool ships no content and no indexers; you bring your own.
Container.Requires: An indexer (Prowlarr, or a Newznab or Torznab indexer) and a download client that you set up yourself.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Database, settings, backups, logs and the API key.

Config.Name: Library
Config.Description: Your magazine library. PeriodiCool moves and renames files here and never deletes them. Run the first library scan as a preview.

Config.Name: Downloads
Config.Description: Your download client's downloads. Mount the same host folder at the same container path as the download client does, so no path mapping is needed.

Config.Name: Downloads folder inside the container
Config.Description: Where the downloads are mounted inside the container. Keep it the same as the Downloads container path above.

Config.Name: Import folder
Config.Description: Optional drop-in folder: files put here are matched and filed into the library.

Config.Name: Import folder inside the container
Config.Description: Set to /import when you use the import folder above.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User the container runs as (Unraid's nobody). PeriodiCool never runs as root.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group the container runs as (Unraid's users).

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Your time zone, for example America/New_York.

Config.Name: Prowlarr API key
Config.Description: Optional. Only a fallback for the first Prowlarr entry; keys can be entered in Settings instead.

Config.Name: SABnzbd API key
Config.Description: Optional. Only a fallback for the first SABnzbd entry; keys can be entered in Settings instead.
